seo.title: Orbit Chat Lab | Kain Chat-First Site
seo.description: Conversation-first website lane with prompt surfaces, search, route-aware replies, FAQ, and intake wiring.

hero.title: Conversation-first websites without collapsing into a chatbot widget.
hero.body: This lane treats chat as the page architecture: prompt seeds, route-aware replies, search, and form escalation all live in the same site runtime.

feature_cards.title: Seeded interactions
feature_cards.body: Start with curated prompts instead of an empty chat box.

feature_cards.title: Action-aware replies
feature_cards.body: The local runtime can explain routes, actors, and next actions instead of echoing canned text.

feature_cards.title: Form handoff
feature_cards.body: Move directly from chat into a structured intake form when needed.

prompt_presets.title: Route to a business site
prompt_presets.prompt: Build me a launch site with pricing and docs
prompt_presets.body: Switch the conversation toward business messaging, pricing, and search.

prompt_presets.title: Route to a 3D site
prompt_presets.prompt: Show me an immersive 3D campaign shell
prompt_presets.body: Pivot toward scene-led storytelling and release surfaces.

prompt_presets.title: Route to actor server
prompt_presets.prompt: I need an actor-based dashboard and route catalog
prompt_presets.body: Pull the conversation toward routes, actors, and operator APIs.

chat_personas.title: Orbit Navigator
chat_personas.body: Routes each request to the right site archetype, surfaces next actions, and keeps the conversation anchored to live routes.

chat_personas.title: Launch Strategist
chat_personas.body: Turns prompt fragments into launch copy, pricing tiers, and onboarding steps without leaving the chat surface.

chat_personas.title: Operator Conductor
chat_personas.body: Translates chat into actor tasks, route plans, and handoff forms for live operators.

chat_modes.title: Brief Builder
chat_modes.body: Captures intent, constraints, and tone into a structured brief from a single conversation.

chat_modes.title: System Planner
chat_modes.body: Builds a system-level plan: routes, actors, integrations, and data collections.

chat_modes.title: Escalation Gate
chat_modes.body: Routes high-signal prompts into forms, operator queues, or realtime channels.

chat_playbooks.title: Intent capture
chat_playbooks.body: Normalize the prompt, extract target archetype, and tag desired launch systems.

chat_playbooks.title: Route escalation
chat_playbooks.body: Convert intent into actor tasks and route the request to the right control surface.

chat_playbooks.title: Brief finalize
chat_playbooks.body: Summarize the conversation into a brief and attach it to the intake queue.

chat_tools.title: Prompt router
chat_tools.body: Maps prompts to archetypes, routes, and output artifacts.

chat_tools.title: Conversation brief
chat_tools.body: Turns chat context into a structured build brief.

chat_tools.title: Route inspector
chat_tools.body: Surfaces live runtime routes and actor ownership.

chat_memory.title: Conversation summary
chat_memory.body: Summaries persist alongside intake payloads for operator review.

chat_memory.title: Persona alignment
chat_memory.body: Track which persona responded to each prompt segment.

chat_memory.title: Outcome tags
chat_memory.body: Apply tags for routed lanes, artifacts, and next actions.

process_steps.title: Seed the conversation
process_steps.body: Start with intent-rich prompt cards instead of leaving visitors in an empty chat box.

process_steps.title: Route to a lane
process_steps.body: Use local prompt and keyword matching to move toward the right archetype or next action.

process_steps.title: Escalate to a form
process_steps.body: Convert a good conversation into a structured intake record without leaving the page.

link_groups.title: Suggested prompt rails
link_groups.body: Use link clusters to pull visitors into better prompts faster.

faq_items.question: Is the assistant wired to a model?
answer: The starter ships a local chat lane backed by seed data and route-aware local responses.
Replace that endpoint later with a real backend or actor system.

faq_items.question: Can I search docs from the same shell?
answer: Yes. The chat lane ships with a search panel and search document index.

handoff.title: Turn chat into a handoff
handoff.body: Use a structured form when the conversation should become a project brief or qualified lead.

fields.name: context
fields.label: Context
fields.placeholder: What should the assistant route next?

search_documents.title: Build me a launch site
search_documents.summary: Route into business_launch content and pricing rails.

search_documents.title: Show actor routes
search_documents.summary: Route into actor mesh and route contract sections.

search_documents.title: Search docs
search_documents.summary: Open the search panel and query the local site index.

chat_seed.text: Tell me what kind of site you want and I will route you to the right build lane.
I can sketch a business homepage, a 3D campaign shell, or an actor-server dashboard.
Ask about routes, docs, forms, or search and I will stay inside the local site system.

actor_roles.name: prompt_router
actor_roles.responsibility: Matches user intent to the right site experience.

actor_roles.name: response_writer
actor_roles.responsibility: Builds next actions and summary cards.

actor_roles.name: handoff_agent
actor_roles.responsibility: Converts a prompt thread into a structured intake record.

server_routes.purpose: returns starter chat payloads and local prompt replies

cta.title: Start from a conversation, not a sitemap.
cta.body: Use the chat lane when prompt flow is the product surface and escalation is part of the design.
